description: This file defines an interface class IOmiProxy within the omi namespace, which provides methods for managing crypted bundles and handling error listeners related to omi_dbus_api interactions. It includes method declarations for mounting/unmounting crypted bundles and registering/unregistering error listeners.

classes.name: IOmiProxy
classes.description: Interface class providing methods to interact with omi_dbus_api, including mounting/unmounting crypted bundles and managing error listeners.

methods.name: mountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Mounts a crypted bundle given its container ID, filesystem image path, and config path; outputs the decrypted config JSON payload path.

methods.name: umountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Unmounts a crypted bundle identified by its container ID.

methods.name: registerListener
methods.description: Registers an error listener callback and returns a listener ID.

methods.name: unregisterListener
methods.description: Unregisters an error listener using its ID.
